intro: Buying, from someone asking for something to the goods on your shelf: requisitions, requests for quote, purchase orders, goods received, inspections and returns. Each step is its own document; a later one can start from an earlier one, or stand alone.
start: Add the suppliers you buy from in Buy › Suppliers, with their terms.
Make a requisition for what is needed and send it for approval.
Turn the approved requisition into a purchase order and send it to the supplier.
Receive the goods against the order when they arrive. They go into stock once the receipt is approved.

articles.summary: Ask several suppliers to price the same items, compare their quotes side by side and award one. The order is then made for that supplier.
